ambient_events: Wind moans down the length of the culvert and dies somewhere in its western dark.
A shape shelters deep in the culvert's mouth and pulls back further as you approach.
description: A great cracked concrete culvert that once carried the works' floodwater away and now carries nothing but wind and the occasional person with nowhere better to shelter. Its mouth gapes westward, into the dark under the wastes.
name: The Culvert
